name: Create a real LifeLens world from WASM
covers: deterministic male and female appearance variants
Core activity to contextual motion mapping
nameplates clear resident head and upper body
nameplates remain visually anchored to their resident
description: Verifies the React-based public observer mounts successfully, loads the real C++ LifeLensCore runtime, and creates a world rather than using fake browser data.
steps: Wait for the status badge to show Core WASM LIVE
Enter 12345 in WorldSeed and click NEW WORLD
Verify the resident cards include both Male and Female Core sex values
Observe all four founders through several automatic simulation refreshes and verify none blink out between refreshes
Pinch or wheel through multiple zoom levels and verify resident bodies stay proportionate to the terrain instead of remaining fixed-size
expected: The status shows Core WASM LIVE, WorldSeed 12345 is shown, Living is 4, all four resident cards and 3D residents remain continuously visible without one-refresh disappearance/reappearance, the founder cards expose authoritative Core sex values and the terrain shows visually distinct male and female 3D residents with different skinned body geometry, garment silhouettes, deterministic clothing, proportions, and head-locked hair while remaining map-scale and clustered near their authoritative Core positions with readable labels, resident body size and separation change with the same world zoom as the terrain while labels remain readable, movement between authoritative Core positions is visually smoothed, movement uses walking animation, supported Core activities select contextual idle/talking/sitting/interact motions, resident animation phases are visibly desynchronized, and compact fallback markers appear only while the 3D asset is still loading or if it fails. Resident labels avoid actor/label overlap while staying close to their resident; displaced labels use a subtle leader line instead of floating ambiguously.

name: Advance simulation time automatically and fast-forward
description: Verifies LifeLens advances continuously without depending on successful terrain rendering and the manual time buttons remain available as fast-forward controls.
steps: Create WorldSeed 42 and read the Day/time label
Observe the Day/time label for several seconds without pressing a time button
expected: The Day/time label advances on its own without pressing a time button, rendering refreshes cannot stop the simulation clock, delayed browser timer callbacks catch up from elapsed wall time, then +1 HOUR advances by an additional hour with Core WASM remaining LIVE.

name: Move observer across deterministic terrain
description: Verifies moving the observer asks Core for a different logical terrain/ecology window without creating fake terrain or resources.
steps: Read the Biome badge above the terrain canvas
Click the right-arrow world truth control twice and inspect the terrain canvas
expected: The Chunk badge shows Chunk 2, 0, the Biome badge reports the Core biome and forest coverage, and deterministic terrain is rendered as one connected relief surface with visible slopes, non-rectangular river or stream paths where hydrology exists, with at most two flow exits per river/stream chunk, no synthetic cross-grid fallback channels, and minor streams/springs progressively hidden at wider zoom levels, and clustered vegetation rather than a debug-like tile grid.

name: Reject empty WorldSeed on mobile
description: Verifies invalid world creation is blocked on the mobile layout.
expected: A visible WorldSeed validation message is shown and no new world request is made.
